Data:Nxs.n.debt.inconclusive.json.label: Clouds at Daybreak
Data:Nxs.n.debt.inconclusive.json.preface: Did anyone ever get to the bottom of that Kaunas business? I could ask around. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.debt.inconclusive.json.desc: Nothing. The Reckoners in Kaunas continue their war, sporadically, for their own knifely reasons. [The Affair of the Forgivable Debt came and went without any Visitors making progress.]

Data:Nxs.n.endeavour.forget.the.matter.j.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.endeavour.forget.the.matter.j.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.eye.corso.ask.corso.json.label: Ask Corso
Data:Nxs.n.eye.corso.ask.corso.json.desc: 'The manuscript was a forgery, sure enough… but the information in it was good. Something funny about that. St Lucia the Eyeless is behind the manifestations. The Meniscate usually charges her with withdrawing the gift of sight. Now she's handing it out instead. Trouble in the Mansus, I reckon.'

Data:Nxs.n.eye.hokobald.ask.hokobald.jso.label: Ask Hokobald
Data:Nxs.n.eye.hokobald.ask.hokobald.jso.preface: Hokobald hadn't shown any interest in Messana before, but now…
Data:Nxs.n.eye.hokobald.ask.hokobald.jso.desc: 'The manifestations in Messana are the work of Lucia the Eyeless, who's long been under the Meniscate's thumb. No more, I think. Lucia shows a promising yearning for change. An ally of mine has pleaded with me to introduce her...'

Data:Nxs.n.eye.serena.ask.serena.json.label: Ask Serena
Data:Nxs.n.eye.serena.ask.serena.json.desc: 'There's even more to it than I thought. There is a Chandler-name, but there's also a Meniscate-name - Lucia the Eyeless. Lucia bestows gifts of blindness at the Meniscate's bidding. Now she's flirting with a Chandler-name, and bestowing gifts of sight. I know Lucia had sometimes been fractious - there is a tradition she was friendly with Ghirbi, and I can't imagine she'd like how the Hours treated him...'

Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.agdistis.speak.to.a.label: Speak to Agdistis
Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.agdistis.speak.to.a.preface: Agdistis attempted to arrange protection for a friend who'd brought a Grunewald curio. How did it end?
Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.agdistis.speak.to.a.desc: 'It was successful, thank you! And my friend agreed, in any case, to dispose of the curio. But a trace remains - a poor wisp - something a little like a Worm but very definitely not a Worm. I am certain of it. A cousin, perhaps, of those Carapace who chose the devouring path... The Bureau, however, would see matters differently. It is rather charming, this poor wisp. Will you offer it the House's protection? I have an idea...'

Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.ehsan.speak.to.ehsa.label: Speak to Ehsan
Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.ehsan.speak.to.ehsa.preface: Ehsan attempted an exorcism of sorts to deal with Grunewald influences. How did it end?
Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.ehsan.speak.to.ehsa.desc: 'It went well. The Grunewald business is over. But there was something odd left over - a Carapace-adjacent entity, I think - no, don't panic - it never took the Nowhere-corruption, it just hung out in good company. It's a hapless little thing, but the Bureau's still sniffing around. I'm certain it's harmless, and Hush House has always been a refuge. Could you give it sanctuary? There is a place it might be useful...'

Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.forget.the.matter.j.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.forget.the.matter.j.preface: Determine that this is no longer relevant. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.grunewald.forget.the.matter.j.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.guest.coquille.ask.coquille.j.label: Ask Coquille
Data:Nxs.n.guest.coquille.ask.coquille.j.preface: What happened with Spencer Hobson and his 'inhabitation of Worms'?
Data:Nxs.n.guest.coquille.ask.coquille.j.desc: 'He seems better. No, I can't believe it either. Some silly adepts found Ebrehel for him - they hoped he'd bear it against the City Unbuilt - but Spencer really doesn't have the breeding. And he's much better now. I understand he's planning to come by Hush House. 'Stopping by,' on his way somewhere else. You could ask him yourself, but he isn't really any more talkative..'

Data:Nxs.n.guest.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.label: Ask Dagmar
Data:Nxs.n.guest.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.preface: What happened with Spencer Hobson and his 'inhabitation of Worms'?
Data:Nxs.n.guest.dagmar.ask.dagmar.json.desc: 'Well honest to Suns I just don't know, Libsy. I sealed him up all right, but I don't think it needed doing. If there are Worms in him they're awfully tame. For Worms. He's been a bit wild. Roaming round Poland with a sword. Chopping up Carabees. Bit of naughty arson. But no worms. He said he was going to come here, to Brancrug. If I understand him right, he's just passing through, on his way somewhere else. But he doesn't really talk any more. Couldn't get much out of him.'

Data:Nxs.n.guest.forget.the.matter.json.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.guest.forget.the.matter.json.preface: Determine that this is no longer relevant. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.guest.forget.the.matter.json.desc: There are matters it is unwise for the Librarian to touch.

Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.down.ref.label: Refuse Entry
Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.down.ref.preface: Spencer Hobson - or whatever wears his shape - will not be permitted entry to Hush House.
Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.down.ref.desc: 'Spencer Hobson, who was a priest, who was a hunter of monsters, who perhaps clothed a monster… Spencer is gone where the mists of Numa go.

Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.out.refu.label: Refuse Entry
Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.out.refu.preface: Spencer Hobson - or whatever wears his shape - will not be permitted entry to Hush House.
Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.out.refu.desc: 'Spencer Hobson, who was a priest, who was a hunter of monsters, who perhaps clothed a monster… Spencer is gone where the mists of Numa go.

Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.trace.bi.label: Bid Farewell
Data:Nxs.n.guest.hobson.spencer.trace.bi.desc: We would like to believe that Spencer passed through the Rowenarium into one of this liminal nearly-realities beyond the Mansus and the Bounds: Nowhere, or Ys, or the lower skies, or the House of the Moon. We would like to believe that he did so to honour his last responsibilities, and that the change in the Rowenarium is in the nature of a valedictory blessing.

Data:Nxs.n.guest.zachary.down.json.label: Down?
Data:Nxs.n.guest.zachary.down.json.preface: What happened with Spencer Hobson and his 'inhabitation of Worms'?
Data:Nxs.n.guest.zachary.down.json.desc: 'Spencer wants to go down. It's the right thing. He's coming here. Please help him. But I don't know why.'

Data:Nxs.n.guest.zachary.out.json.label: Out?
Data:Nxs.n.guest.zachary.out.json.preface: What happened with Spencer Hobson and his 'inhabitation of Worms'?
Data:Nxs.n.guest.zachary.out.json.desc: 'Spencer wants to go out. It's the right thing. He's coming here. Please help him. But I don't know why.'

Data:Nxs.n.horizon.ignore.the.ysien.json.label: Ignore the Ysien
Data:Nxs.n.horizon.ignore.the.ysien.json.preface: Determine that the Ysien is no business of the Librarian. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.horizon.ignore.the.ysien.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.arun.ask.arun.json.label: Ask Arun
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.arun.ask.arun.json.preface: Did Arun really manage to meet Ferezeref the Magpie, Name of the Moth, backstage at the opera house?
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.arun.ask.arun.json.desc: 'As a matter of fact, yes. A profitable chat. The Moth - I am excited to say - has found two other Hours to move against the Madrugad, and against Calyptra. Accordingly the Moth has planted his black-and-white flowers in the dreams of the opera audience...'

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.conclude.json.label: Conclude
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.conclude.json.preface: Decline further involvement in the Venice business. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.conclude.json.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.failed.conclude.jso.label: Conclude
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.failed.conclude.jso.preface: Decline further involvement in the Venice business. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.failed.conclude.jso.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.hokobald.hokobalds..label: Hokobald's Exploits
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.hokobald.hokobalds..preface: Did Hokobald manage to 'take full advantage' of the oncoming operatic disaster?
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.hokobald.hokobalds..desc: 'Yes. A memorable occasion. The walls dripped. The chorus screamed. But there has been an irritating development. The Moth is scheming against Calyptra - against the Madrugad in particular. That scheme demanded the successful performance of the opera. That scheme has raised piebald flowers in the dreams of the audience…'

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.hokobald.hokobalds..label: Hokobald's Frustrations
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.hokobald.hokobalds..preface: Did Hokobald manage to 'take full advantage' of the oncoming operatic disaster?
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.hokobald.hokobalds..desc: 'Are you trying to annoy me, Librarian? No. The Moth is scheming against Calyptra - against the Madrugad in particular. That scheme demanded the successful performance of the opera. That scheme has raised piebald flowers in the dreams of the audience…'

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.morgen.morgens.expl.label: Morgen's Exploits
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.morgen.morgens.expl.preface: Did Morgen enjoy her hoped-for opening night catastrophe in Venice?
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.morgen.morgens.expl.desc: 'Very diverting, thank you, my dear Librarian, very diverting. And there is a more diverting development still. The Moth has found allies to move against Calyptra. His first move is in the dreams of the opera audience - where black-and-white flowers now bloom...'

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.morgen.morgens.frus.label: Morgen's Frustrations
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.morgen.morgens.frus.preface: Did Morgen enjoy her hoped-for opening night catastrophe in Venice?
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.morgen.morgens.frus.desc: 'Disappointing, Librarian. It went off rather well. Rather too well. You did not perhaps help some difficult Samaritan who has spoiled my fun? Did you? No matter. There is a more diverting development that compensates enough. The Moth has found allies to move against Calyptra. His first move is in the dreams of the opera audience - where black-and-white flowers now bloom...'

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.olympe.ask.olympe.j.label: Ask Olympe
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.olympe.ask.olympe.j.preface: Olympe's friend was the impresario of the Invisible Opera. She had hoped to help him succeed in the daunting task of staging a performance. Did she?
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.olympe.ask.olympe.j.desc: 'Yes, Librarian, and thank you! Perhaps it was your advice that made all the difference. 'Everything fails until it succeeds' - a very History sentiment, isn't it? And now there is something else from History. The Moth is moving against Calyptra - and I believe he has allies. His first move is a matter of flowers - black-and-white flowers in the dreams of the audience...'

Data:Nxs.n.invisible.salvaged.conclude.j.label: Conclude
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.salvaged.conclude.j.preface: Decline further involvement in the Venice business. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.invisible.salvaged.conclude.j.desc: The Librarian can't get involved in everything.

Data:Nxs.n.mystique.douglas.ask.douglas..label: Ask Douglas
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.douglas.ask.douglas..preface: What happened with the fad for religions? Follow up with Douglas
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.douglas.ask.douglas..desc: 'Couple of upcoming Long, we've put them where they won't cause any more trouble… but there's another Long behind some of it. Black Elie, runs the Ivory Dawn, which is confusing if you ask me. Sort of chiaroscuro, I spose. Old as trees, used to be a priestess and an Obliviate and all sorts. Anyway she's working with Ys now, if you can believe it. And she's taken an interest in Yvette Southey. You know Yvette, course you do. Wants to turn her over to Ys, some sort of deal to protect the Bounds. I don't like it, Librarian. I don't know much about Ys, but nothing I've heard is good, and no-one's ever said they can be trusted.'

Data:Nxs.n.mystique.fraser.ask.fraser.js.label: Ask Fraser
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.fraser.ask.fraser.js.preface: Fraser suspected that one of the new religions was influenced by the Obliviates. Has he learnt anything more?
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.fraser.ask.fraser.js.desc: 'Yes. Not the Obliviates, exactly - an Obliviate. Or she used to be one. Black Elie. She's had what you might call an odd career. She's looking for Yvette Southey. Yvette, as you might know, is descended from the line of Ys. Elie has made an arrangement with Ys, to render them Yvette, in exchange for their assistance in preserving the Bounds... it's a very clever arrangement, Librarian. I've been talking to Elie. I think it's for the best.'

Data:Nxs.n.mystique.serena.ask.serena.js.label: Ask Serena
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.serena.ask.serena.js.preface: What's happening with the fad for solar cults? Does she still think it was nothing unusual?
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.serena.ask.serena.js.desc: 'I'm not often wrong, but I'm not infallible either. One of the cults is different. The Ivory Dawn. It's sponsored by Black Elie. She's a Nectar-long; she was an Obliviate; I'm not sure what she is now. Always used to be a sensible soul, our Elie. But she's working with Ys now. And she's looking for Yvette Southey. She intends to render her to Ys, for their services in protecting the bounds. I don't like it. Ethics aside, Ys can't be trusted. Ys can never be trusted.'

Data:Nxs.n.mystique.yvette.ask.yvette.js.label: Ask Yvette
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.yvette.ask.yvette.js.preface: What happened with the Ivory Dawn? Follow up with Yvette.
Data:Nxs.n.mystique.yvette.ask.yvette.js.desc: 'I met with the Ivory Dawn…and with their patron. Her name's Elie. She's very old. She's told me a little about my ancestry - the 'pale line' - the connection to Ys behind the wave. She wants me to go there. It'll win protection for the world, she tells me. I believe her, actually. She strikes me as a woman of integrity. She let me leave freely. And I won't deny I'm curious, and tempted... but I'm not nearly ready to take a leap like that.'

Data:Nxs.n.reverend.douglas.ask.douglas..label: Ask Douglas
Data:Nxs.n.reverend.douglas.ask.douglas..preface: What caused the Reverend to Open? And what's happening to him now?
Data:Nxs.n.reverend.douglas.ask.douglas..desc: 'He's been harder to close than we expected. We never worked out exactly what had happened to him. Not any Knock-Hour or Knock-Name you've ever heard of, certainly. So we never knew exactly what to do about it…'

Data:Nxs.n.reverend.ehsan.ask.ehsan.json.label: Ask Ehsan
Data:Nxs.n.reverend.ehsan.ask.ehsan.json.preface: What caused the Reverend to Open? And what's happening to him now?
Data:Nxs.n.reverend.ehsan.ask.ehsan.json.desc: 'I was wrong, Librarian. Whatever touched this man was neither the Mother of Ants nor the Horned-Axe. I wish I could leave the matter to the Bureau. But I'm a healer before I'm anything else, and I feel responsible.'

Data:Nxs.n.reverend.forget.the.matter.js.label: Forget the Matter
Data:Nxs.n.reverend.forget.the.matter.js.preface: Determine that this is no longer relevant. [Concludes]
Data:Nxs.n.reverend.forget.the.matter.js.desc: There are matters it is unwise for the Librarian to touch.

Data:Nxs.n.revolution.arthur.the.revolut.label: The Revolution?
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.arthur.the.revolut.preface: How goes the revolution in the Bounds near Meshad? I could ask Arthur.
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.arthur.the.revolut.desc: 'The rebels - they're martial Zurvanists, more or less - they're holding their own. But I'm worried. They've long followed a Lionsmith-Name we call the Fourfold. But I have spoken with one of their mobeds, and learnt that they have been receiving overtures from a power of fire in darkness. Time and fate; fire and darkness. They revere these things.'

Data:Nxs.n.revolution.azita.legion.suppl.label: Legion Supplies?
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.azita.legion.suppl.preface: Did Azita get the Legion the taenite substitute its quartermasters needed? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.azita.legion.suppl.desc: 'Yes. A fallen Star. It was a little chatty - perhaps you know how these visitors can be - but split small enough, it's almost silent. The Legion hasn't complained. And it's turned the tide for them against the rebels.'

Data:Nxs.n.revolution.chaima.a.contract..label: A Contract Officer?
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.chaima.a.contract..preface: Did Chaima accept a contract to fight with the Legion? I could ask her.
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.chaima.a.contract..desc: 'Yes. I mistrust these rebels, these 'Fourfold Zurvanists'. Whether they remain faithful to their Lionsmith-Name, or not.'

Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.a.mercena.label: A Mercenary Act?
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.a.mercena.preface: Did Chaima accept a contract to fight with the Legion? If she's not around, I could ask Hokobald.
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.a.mercena.desc: 'Yes. She has led attacks against the rebels, these 'Fourfold Zurvanists'. I imagine the Legion is glad of her help. She is formidable, for a woman.'

Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.a.taenite.label: A Taenite Revolution?
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.a.taenite.preface: Did Azita get the Legion the taenite substitute its quartermasters needed? If she's not around, I could ask Hokobald.
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.a.taenite.desc: 'Yes. She divided a fallen Star. The fragments have given the Legion what they wanted. Azita has been paid. But Star-visitors can be loquacious - even so divided. The woman is a fool.'

Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.revolutio.label: Revolution in the Bounds?
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.revolutio.preface: How goes the revolution in the Bounds near Meshad? Hokobald apparently had an interest.
Data:Nxs.n.revolution.hokobald.revolutio.desc: 'These rebels - these 'Fourfold Zurvanists' - they are causing the Legion some difficulty. But the power they serve is a blunted claw. I have offered to introduce them to other masters. They should listen to me.'

Data:Nxs.n.rising.connie.hear.connies.tr.label: Hear Connie's Trouble
Data:Nxs.n.rising.connie.hear.connies.tr.preface: 'The Rising While has given me my own oracle now. I don't like it much better than the other one.'
Data:Nxs.n.rising.connie.hear.connies.tr.desc: ''It is in the gift of the youngest Oculate that the Monster Mother keeps the Jewel of Ys from the Pale Mother.' Echidna is the Mother of Monsters, I know that. The youngest Constable-Oculate - excuse my blushes - is me. But the rest is just so much crossword puzzle.'
